title: Suspicious Command In Registry Run Key Value
description:
Detects a value written to a Run / RunOnce autostart registry key (Sysmon EID 13 registry set)
where the value data points at a script interpreter, a living-off-the-land binary, an encoded
command, or a user-writable staging path. This is a common userland persistence technique
(e.g. PowerShell Empire writing a logon autostart entry). The TargetObject contains match on
...\CurrentVersion\Run also covers RunOnce and the Wow6432Node / HKLM equivalents.
sigma: SELECT * FROM logs WHERE EventID=13 AND (TargetObject LIKE '%\\Software\\Microsoft\\Windows\\CurrentVersion\\Run%' ESCAPE '\' AND (Details LIKE '%powershell%' ESCAPE '\' OR Details LIKE '%pwsh%' ESCAPE '\' OR Details LIKE '%cmd /c%' ESCAPE '\' OR Details LIKE '%cmd.exe /c%' ESCAPE '\' OR Details LIKE '%wscript%' ESCAPE '\' OR Details LIKE '%cscript%' ESCAPE '\' OR Details LIKE '%mshta%' ESCAPE '\' OR Details LIKE '%regsvr32%' ESCAPE '\' OR Details LIKE '%rundll32%' ESCAPE '\' OR Details LIKE '%-enc%' ESCAPE '\' OR Details LIKE '%-encodedcommand%' ESCAPE '\' OR Details LIKE '%FromBase64String%' ESCAPE '\' OR Details LIKE '%-w hidden%' ESCAPE '\' OR Details LIKE '%-windowstyle hidden%' ESCAPE '\' OR Details LIKE '%\\AppData\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR Details LIKE '%\\Temp\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR Details LIKE '%\\Users\\Public\\%' ESCAPE '\' OR Details LIKE '%\\ProgramData\\%' ESCAPE '\'))
